approvers: Owner/partner, main contractor or site manager, window and coating manufacturer for warranty
reason: ACHV is a contractor too, and I don't want a competitor on my site seeing my programme and my clients. We don't buy this today, so it would also mean a new supplier and a new budget line for a job we already handle with cheap film and tape.
objection: I can't risk a peelable coating marking or leaving residue on coated glass or anodised frames, and I would be handing site access and my programme to a competitor.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, and careful site housekeeping. We accept the occasional cleaning or replacement cost.
would_change_my_mind: Written compatibility confirmation from the glass and frame manufacturers for coated glass and finishes, plus a reference from another glazing contractor, and the option of supply-only product with no ACHV staff on my site.
